design.withinParticipant: complete: every participant meets all four content states once, order from a Williams 4x4 square (carryover-balanced)
design.betweenParticipant: AI disclosure: independent fair draw per participant (p=0.5)
design.allocation: disclosure = Bernoulli(0.5); Williams row = least started count within the drawn disclosure group, campaign and protocol version; themes = 4 least-used of 6 within campaign/protocol; theme→position = permutation minimising 10*count(disclosure,theme,state)+count(theme,position); base = least used within theme
design.entry: open: top URL starts a session in the default campaign (config.defaultCampaign = live campaign hash); #invite and #entry links still work; no capacity limit
design.flow: intro → per case ×4, identical: materials (2-item check, retry), read, cognition (readcheck + 12), edit, post (7), trust_post (4), perception (9, with report and sources on the right), responsibility (9) → reflection (free text) → recall (6 disclosure-recognition items) → complete (keyword only)

production_verification.dia_content_blocker_check: Dia (fresh profile): consent → intro → materials_1 OK on e7a129c2
production_verification.copy_guard: tests/copy-guard.mjs passed on production: report/source copy blocked, 20-char in-editor copy allowed, whole-editor copy blocked, paste logged
production_verification.restart_check: tests/restart-check.mjs passed on production (withdraw → restart → new session)
